output.why: The specification documents already disagree with each other: Section 7.1.13 (Part1.pdf p.43) specifies the SG Unit-2 waste water transfer pumps as 'Two (2) nos. (1W+1S)', whereas the ETP P&ID (Part3.pdf p.146) and Datasheet A (Part4.pdf p.58) specify them as 'Two (2W) nos.' (two working, zero standby). Making one pump standby reduces the working pumping capacity from 210 m3/hr (2 x 105 m3/hr) to 105 m3/hr, which conflicts with the 2W requirement in the P&ID and Datasheet.
